data.name: Parin
data.gender_notes: Parin is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parin comes from the Sanskrit word ‘pari’ meaning ‘over’ or ‘above’ and ‘n’ meaning ‘lord’ or ‘master’. This name is often given to a child born under the belief that they will grow up to be a leader, a protector, or a wise ruler. The name Parin carries the meaning “Lord, Master” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parin usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Parin belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parin total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
